entities.name: Garenbrig
entities.description: The green-aligned court of the Realm on Eldraine, ruled by giants and exemplifying Strength.

entities.name: Great Henge
entities.description: Massive stone ring built by giants, a sundial and portal to the Wilds.

entities.name: Castle Garenbrig
entities.description: Enormous giant-built castle beneath and around a stone outcropping.

entities.name: The Wilds
entities.description: Wild region that Garenbrig borders and the Henge connects to.

entities.name: Elven Lords
entities.description: Rulers who once enslaved mankind and were overthrown.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Garenbrig and all other courts fell.

entities.name: Lord Skitter
entities.description: Rat who rules the dwarven ruins beneath Edgewall.

events.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords, the five knightly courts are created, and Garenbrig is established around the Great Henge.
events.quote: The court of Garenbrig was established around the Great Henge .

events.summary: Garenbrig falls to the New Phyrexian invaders.
events.quote: Garenbrig and all other courts fell before the invaders.

events.summary: Yorvo disappears from the castle during the Invasion and reappears in Stormkeld months later.
events.quote: Yorvo disappeared from the castle during the Invasion

relations.quote: Garenbrig is ruled by King Yorvo , a giant .
Atop the outcropping stands the Great Henge and its portal.
